name: bidetbeacon
description: Community map of masajid and restaurants with bidets, washlets, and handheld sprayers — focused on the US, Canada, and the UK.

scripts.test: node --test scripts/test-app-core.cjs && node scripts/test-manual-spots.cjs && node scripts/validate-bidet-seed.cjs --warn-only
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/test-filter-layout.mjs && node scripts/test-legend-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-bidet-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && node scripts/validate-bidet-seed.cjs --warn-only && npm run test:e2e
